top_signals.title: Mediators push to break US-Iran deadlock
top_signals.summary: Negotiators have shuttled between the American and Iranian officials in an effort to renew talks to end the seven-month war
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Paramount Pitches $6 Billion of Cost Savings to Contain Leverage
top_signals.summary: Paramount Skydance Corp. is promising to cut $6 billion in costs within three years as it looks to lock in lenders for its blockbuster Warner Bros. Discovery Inc. acquisition.
